question: Can you tell me the numeric value of the active council district in Austin which has the highest number of bike trips that start and end within the same district, but not at the same station?
sql:
WITH trip_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    SAFE_CAST(end_station_id AS INT64) AS end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE SAFE_CAST(end_station_id AS INT64) IS NOT NULL
    AND start_station_id != SAFE_CAST(end_station_id AS INT64)
  GROUP BY start_station_id, SAFE_CAST(end_station_id AS INT64)
),
active_stations AS (
  SELECT station_id, council_district 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` 
  WHERE status = 'active'
)
SELECT 
  start_st.council_district AS district
FROM trip_pairs tp
JOIN active_stations start_st ON tp.start_station_id = start_st.station_id
JOIN active_stations end_st ON tp.end_station_id = end_st.station_id
WHERE start_st.council_district = end_st.council_district
GROUP BY start_st.council_district
ORDER BY SUM(tp.cnt) DESC
LIMIT 1
